headword: {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}
reading: ふりこみてすうりょう

definitions.explanation: The fee charged by a bank or financial institution for processing a money transfer. A common everyday banking term in Japan, where bank transfers are a standard payment method.

examples.japanese: {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
{振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦ネット→ネット：05279_netto⟧バンキング⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: If you use online banking, the transfer fee is often cheaper.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧ (bank transfer) and ⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧ (handling fee). In Japan, bank transfers (⟦{振込|ふりこみ}→振込：05421_furikomi⟧) are one of the most common payment methods for rent, utilities, and business transactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: a transfer fee is charged
- {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: the transfer fee is free
- {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bear the transfer fee
- {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: transfer fee included

USAGE:
Transfer fees vary depending on the bank, whether the transfer is within the same bank or to a different bank, and whether it is done at an ATM, at a counter, or online. Many Japanese banks offer lower {振込|ふりこみ}{手数料|てすうりょう} for online transactions.
